products.name: Birxment Calendar
products.tagline: One private team board for every company calendar you work with.
products.description: A private multi-company schedule aggregator I built for real campaign work: connect Google and Outlook/ICS sources, label each as a company, and see conflicts and free time on one board without leaking join links.
products.problem: Working across several client companies meant living in many Google and Outlook calendars at once. The team could not answer a simple question: who is free, who is double-booked, and which company owns this hour? Sharing raw calendar links exposed join URLs and meeting notes. Spreadsheets and screenshots went stale within minutes.
products.solution: Birxment Calendar pulls every connected company calendar into one color-coded team schedule. Members see availability, conflicts, and free slots. An optional public page shows busy/free and titles only: no descriptions, locations, or meeting URLs. Admins connect sources, set company labels and colors, import ICS/PDF when OAuth is not available, and hit Sync now instead of waiting for the next cron tick.
products.howBuilt: I designed it as a monorepo: Next.js dashboard, Bun HTTP API, Drizzle on Postgres, Redis + BullMQ for ingest and push jobs, Better Auth for email/password (first user is admin). Cron ingests Google OAuth and ICS feeds into normalized event state; the UI reads Postgres rather than hitting Google on every page load. Production runs on containerized Railway-style hosting with Supabase Postgres. The live production instance stays private because it holds real client calendars; this portfolio only shows sanitized mock screenshots.
includes: Multi-source sync: Google OAuth + ICS/iCal (Outlook publish links)
Company labels, colors, and company filter
Free-time finder across the team week
Day, week, month, and agenda views
Private authenticated schedule for the team
Import .ics files or Outlook print PDFs
Manual meeting entry when a source is missing
Admin user management and Sync now
idealFor: Agencies and freelancers with many client calendars
Ops teams that need one wall of company meetings
Teams that cannot share raw Google/Outlook links company-wide
Anyone who wants a similar private calendar hub built for them
